meta.source: Reserve Bank of India (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Policy rates and auction results are final when announced. The Handbook restates a few effective dates between editions (newest edition wins, differences listed in rates-policy meta). Lending and deposit rates: each monthly release repeats the full history; the newest release wins.
meta.coverage: How much each state borrows from the market each month since April 2018, gross and net of repayments
meta.note: RBI Bulletin, Market Borrowings of State Governments (DBIE report 38; also 319). Converted from rupees to ₹ crore. A month in which a state raised nothing is printed as empty. From May 2023 the RBI's table labels these state rows with the central government's item names ('Government of India Gross Amount Raised'); they are read by state and by gross or net.
